note: Owner-chosen families and roles for the community-refinement pilot (issue #5), drawn only from the C360 sem* product repositories (owner ruling, 2026-10-09). Each repository is assigned whole to one split. Only `include`, `exclude` and `max_file_bytes` may change to bring a family into the 50-250 entity range. `include` entries are repo-relative globs (non-recursive); a matching directory is copied recursively. `exclude` globs match repo-relative paths. Each repository is exported with `git archive` at its pinned `commit` from the sibling checkout named by `local`, so uncommitted files are never captured; `export_exclude` entries are git glob pathspecs. `license` is the SPDX identifier read from `license_file`. Where the owner named a README for a family it is included; elsewhere 'non-test' is read as the package's non-test Go files.

families.role: code and doc about the same responsibility
families.notes: Owner subtree: internal/ and cmd/ non-test Go plus the root README.md.

families.role: docs with multiple topics; isolated entities
families.notes: Owner subtree docs/*.md (top level; docs/evidence excluded) trimmed by the owner's size rule: files of 50,000 bytes or more are dropped, which removes only validation-throughput.md (57,502 bytes, 61 entities). The remaining 18 documents keep every topic the docs cover.

natsclient/ is one directory, so it is trimmed by file to the subject its README documents: the Client connection hub (client.go), its options, errors, heartbeat, the KVStore abstraction (kv.go), tracing and the package doc. Stream, consumer, delivery-settlement, request, KV key-contract/spec/retention, JetStream metrics and the storage_* observability files are excluded; references to them are dangling edges.
Owner subtree: message/ and payloadregistry/ non-test Go; message/README.md is not Go and is excluded.
Owner subtree: processor/graph-clustering/ non-test Go plus its README.md.

processor/rule/ is trimmed by file to four topics named by the files' own package comments: cron scheduling (cron_*, schedule_tracker), substitution contexts (*_substitution), stateful evaluation (state_tracker, stateful_evaluator) and payload projection (payload_projection, projection_*), plus the package doc. The processor hub, actions, entity watcher, configuration, factories and the expression/ subpackage are excluded; references to them are dangling edges.

service/ is one directory of helpers, so it is trimmed by a size rule: files of 12,000 bytes or more are dropped. This removes the hubs (service_manager, component_manager, message_logger, base, storage_observability and its metrics, metrics_forwarder, message_logger_http, component_manager_http) and keeps the 25 smaller helper files, including the lexically similar *_http, *_config, metrics, forwarder and registry helpers.

component/ is trimmed to component lifecycle, ports and the registry hub. Excluded: the flowgraph/ subpackage; lifecycle_test_suite.go and test_helpers.go, which are test support although not *_test.go; the port codec and port facts files; and the schema and validation files. References to them are dangling edges.

processor/agentic-loop/ is trimmed to the loop's lifecycle in two long files: state.go (LoopManager, loop entity lifecycle and state) and handlers.go (the handlers that drive the loop), plus the package doc. component.go, the trajectory, governance, approval, context and metrics files and the internal/, lessonmatch/ and prompt/ subpackages are excluded; references to them are dangling edges.

Owner subtree processor/source-manifest/ non-test Go plus configs/tiers/README.md, less workbench_capabilities.go (32 entities), the UI capability advertisement, which the tiers README does not discuss.

ui/src/ Svelte and TypeScript without tests (*.test.ts and ui/src/tests/); app.css and app.html are not parsed. Trimmed to the UI shell: routes, components, API clients and state. The typed contracts (lib/contracts/) and the graph layout and rendering engine (lib/graph/) are excluded; references to them are dangling edges. No file carries a generated-code marker; app.d.ts is the hand-kept SvelteKit ambient stub.
